reviewer: independent_review: source-and-reference review; separate from benchmark author

cases.reason: `notify-before-suspension` states Signal without L is allowed and `signal-and-reacquire` shows one mutation while L held; neither states the general condition-mutation obligation or Broadcast lock optionality.
Explicit signal before any waiter has no stored notification; later Wait needs a later signal.

findings.reason: Signal/Broadcast have no effect with no registered waiter; runtime-reference/sema.go:631-638,668-675 and bounded TestCondSignalBeforeWait support this.
Wait registers before unlocking; runtime-reference/sema.go:578-591 says an already-notified ticket returns without parking; Signal need not hold L.
Wait reacquires L and documentation says lock competitors can win; condition loop is prescribed in cond.go:52-65.
Broadcast wakes the current notified list; runtime-reference/sema.go:631-648 resets notifications to current waiter count; subsequent Wait needs a new notification.
copyChecker and method entry sites in cond.go:67-109 support initialization and copied-address panic before operations.
Wait has no context input, docs explicitly require a Signal/Broadcast to unblock and L is reacquired before returning.
